name: FabBazaar
description: Search Flesh and Blood card printings and manage wants lists with comprehensive filtering for editions, foilings, and pricing.
description_for_model: Comprehensive Flesh and Blood card database with advanced search capabilities and personal collection management. Features: (1) Card search with traditional IDs (WTR216), MongoDB printing IDs, price filters, editions, foilings, rarities, and format legality. (2) Personal wants list management with Bearer token authentication - view, search, and filter your wants by priority and card name. (3) Specialized ID extraction for bulk operations. (4) Binder management for collection tracking. User-specific features require Bearer token authentication.

auth.description: Bearer token authentication for secure access to personal wants lists and binders. Generate tokens via the FabBazaar web interface at https://fabbazaar.app/mcp-integration. Required for user-specific features like wants list and collection management.
